title: I Have Called Thee by Thy Name
reflectionQuestion: The voice called the people by their two names. It said: fear not. It promised waters that would not overflow and fire that would not burn. Then it gathered the sons and daughters from the four directions. What is it to be told you have been called by name, and that the waters you are about to pass through will not be deep enough to drown you?
